hypothesis: Center only one initial layout bias, holding the other 88 of 89 initial scalars, observed histories, inference, loss and update budget fixed; test fitting stability and transfer to fresh ordered event structures.

design.training: Exact saturation-v1 1152-event observed NAND training tape; identical bytes, order and full outcome likelihood for both arms. No additional examples, gold roles or participant-order labels.
design.initialization: Standard UnsaturatedFactorOrderEncoder versus existing centered_encoder: change only layout.0.bias to -(2/3)*sum(layout.0.weight). Other 88 scalars identical; same 89 trainable parameters. Bias remains trainable, no prescribed word/layout polarity. Verify exact initial tensors and the prescribed one-scalar difference, not equal whole-model fingerprints.
design.holdout: Two new ordered interaction families relay4/fork_return5, four/five active participants and four/five events, same existing kef/ruz and wom/jit words. Guard against prior ordered graphs up to active-entity relabeling even ignoring edge direction. All layouts, laws, modes, role reversals and four nonuniform anchor patterns retained without outcome filtering. Withheld cells mean absent from TRAINING; these lexical-layout cells have already been opened in prior studies and are not fresh lexical-generalization evidence.
design.retention: Opened bilingual-v1, lexical-v1, binding-v1 and saturation-v1 banks. Compare original archived lexical-v1, binding factor-v1 and saturation unsaturated-v1 predictions respectively, plus paired current standard predictions. Archived weights/traces never refitted or recollected.
design.controls: Paired standard-unsaturated initialization. Final-only lexical mask/swap with the same canonical prefix. Separate evaluator-only native-action references. Historical GRU/additive outcomes remain context, not fresh-bank architecture comparators.
design.decision: Centered candidate must pass unchanged per-cell/pair/probability/control thresholds at EVERY seed/law; observed train mean NLL<=.05, zero native/archived/paired exact regressions, and no mean fresh NLL increase versus paired standard. Otherwise REVISE_CENTERING_HYPOTHESIS. Retain every seed and adverse probability change. KEEP_CENTERED_INITIALIZATION would support only this bounded initialization comparison; ties do not establish exclusive advantage.
design.publication: Publish source/protocol/recipe/all data hashes before fitting; publish all ten actual checkpoints before collection. Offline publication SHA arguments are attestations verified against GitHub outside the runner.
design.failure: One research fit/collection attempt with exclusive output directories. No retries, seed selection, extra fitting or early stopping. Collect all completed seeds including training-fit failures. Invalid or incomplete inventories stop. Synthetic invariant tests are labeled separately.
design.limits: Public same-team experiment, not independent scientific custody. Known binary physics, supplied identity resolution/token boundaries, two directed contact alternatives, full endpoint feedback and existing rank-one structure. Equal exposure/update budgets do not establish matched consumed compute. G3 stays open; no production promotion or G4 advance.
